// diagnostic

E3223

Inline asm operands do not match the Jet signature: missing/unknown named input, duplicate or missing `; -> return`, or unaudited clobber/target register (D-FFI-ASM1)

What

Inline asm operands do not match the Jet signature: missing/unknown named input, duplicate or missing `; -> return`, or unaudited clobber/target register (D-FFI-ASM1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Make the asm operands, return marker, clobbers, and target registers match the Jet signature.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3223: tests/ui/ffi_asm_missing_return_anchor.stderr.

Error [E3223]: This inline assembly operand contract is incomplete
  --> tests/ui/ffi_asm_missing_return_anchor.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     """
    |     ^^^
 Why: A value-returning assembly body needs exactly one `; -> return` anchor
 Fix: Bind each Jet parameter as `{name}`, mark one result with `; -> return`, and list overwritten registers on `; clobbers …`
